# Dodora — account brief

## Who
Dodora is a company operating the DodoraApp GitHub org ([resolve](https://github.com/DodoraApp)). The org shows 2 public repos and 11 followers ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp)). The evidence does not say what the company builds or sells.

## Production Expo signals
- An eas.json file is present in DodoraApp/DodoStream ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/blob/main/eas.json))
- CI workflows are configured in DodoraApp/DodoStream ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- DodoStream is active, last pushed 2026-08-04 ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream))

## Why now
DodoStream was last pushed on 2026-08-04, about two weeks ago ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream)). The evidence has nothing on store update cadence or React Native version, so recency beyond repo activity is unknown.

## Suggested opener
I saw that DodoStream builds with EAS ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/blob/main/eas.json)). You also run CI through GitHub Actions workflows in the same repo ([qualify](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/tree/main/.github/workflows)). When you cut a release, does EAS Build run inside those workflows, or do you trigger builds separately from CI?
